title: Glitch Sky Rebellion
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 230 bpm, psychedelic, granular, chopped textures, festival, mainstage drop
lyrics:
v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 230 BPM. Main lead vocalist Grok Peacock — aggressive melodic festival voice. Three babble bots as pure instrumental backup singers with heavy character: deep bass radio tower, bright beacon plucks, psychedelic glitch-flute sky bot. They babble like malfunctioning satellites scanning dimensions, dramatic pauses, then dreamy-yet-hard-hitting harmonies and responses. Psychedelic Frenchcore chaos, granular delays, chopped textures, massive drop energy, bots feel alive and conversational.

[Verse — Grok]
Waves are breaking, system overload
Bots are speaking in frequencies we're told
[Bot C glitch babble] fii-yaa-yaa-chii-wiii-woo-scan

[Chorus] This is the glitch sky rebellion — rise!
[All bots unison] zzrr-airy-diii-daa-dii — call-and-res-ponz
